verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The address is squeezed into a cramped 3-line '4275 / Country / Club Dr' column beside the date, and 'keaton.us' is too small to read. The large model photo floats as a separate block below the pattern panel and is not right-aligned with it, which leaves a dead white strip on the right. The model's head is also cropped at the top. A spaces things a bit more evenly from top to bottom, with similar top and bottom margins and a taller photo. B is pushed up and leaves a large empty area at the bottom.
